scene: The cat purrs musical chimes and reveals three travel tickets.
picture: A flat side view along a lively transit terminal. On the far left rests a red funicular railway car. Up high runs a concrete beam carrying a sleek yellow monorail car. Left of centre, the elderly man pats the silver cat atop its crate. On the far right stands a driverless green rickshaw.
shown: a sleek yellow monorail door waits open on an elevated track up high
a red funicular car sits ready at its slanted rail stop on the far left
a green automated rickshaw stands waiting with its passenger seat empty on the far right
